title: node-policy v1
description: What a node lets a hub start on it (remote plan step R9): the repositories it has registered, the engine profiles it offers, and how many sessions a hub may start on it in one UTC day. Written by the node's owner, on the node, in <HordeHome>/node/policy.json; never written from the link, and no verb carries any of it. Its LISTS are here and not in the engine configuration because a rule's set holds one value per key: a repository is an id mapped to a folder, which is a definition, not a setting. The permission ceiling is a setting and lives in the engine configuration (core/config-keys.json, remote.permissionCeiling: L1 and L4 only, lower-only), so it resolves through the one resolver like every other setting. core/NodePolicy.ps1 reads this file and enforces the rules a draft-07 schema cannot say: every path absolute and with no '..' segment, a worktree root that is not inside the clone, each repository id once, each profile once, and the spawn cap at most 1000.

repos.description: The registered clones. A spawn names a repository by id (link-verbs.v1 repo-id); one this list does not hold is refused.

repoId.description: As link-verbs.v1 repo-id: the normalised origin, host then owner then name.

path.description: The clone's folder, absolute. A spawn with no worktree runs here (decision of 2026-10-05: an orc may run in the registered clone).

worktreeRoot.description: The folder that holds this repository's worktrees, absolute. A spawn naming a worktree runs in <worktreeRoot>\<name> and nowhere else. Absent: the sibling folder <path>-worktrees, the convention every repository here follows.

profiles.description: The engine profiles a hub may name in a spawn, by name. A profile not listed is refused even if the engine configuration defines it.

dailySpawnCap.description: Sessions a hub may start on this node per UTC day, counted from the node's own request journal. 0 refuses every remote spawn. Absent: 32 (core/NodePolicy.ps1, the founder's decision of 2026-10-11: generous, not security by limiting power).

sessionStores.description: The stores that NAME this node's sessions and that it uses, by store id (core/ownership.json): X2 the agent's control files, W8 the other agent control files core/identity lists, W1 the wezfleet registry, X1 the pane-sessions files, W5 the run reports (read through the runs W3 and rosters W4, which must be whole too). When every store listed here was read whole and the list was not cut, sessions.list says membershipComplete known true (link-verbs v1, verbs version 2) and the hub drops a session the list leaves out instead of carrying it. A store not listed does not count; a store that only gives fields (X3, X4, X5, R1, W2, W6) cannot be listed. Absent: the node claims nothing, and the hub carries as before. Never inferred from a missing folder: the node's owner writes it. At least one store, each once (core/NodePolicy.ps1). Ledger core-projection L-101.
